name: Energy Storage & Power-Dense Systems Integration
summary: The mechanical-engineering side of storing and delivering energy in mobile machines: batteries, fuel cells, flywheels and compact engines, pack design and thermal safety.

topics.name: Energy and power density metrics and the Ragone plot
Battery cell formats and mechanical pack design (structure, compression, vibration)
Battery thermal behaviour and pack thermal management
Thermal runaway, propagation prevention and pack safety
Structural batteries and multifunctional energy storage
Fuel cell systems: PEM stacks, balance of plant and hydrogen storage
Thermal energy storage and phase-change materials
Compact power sources: micro gas turbines, small engines and range extenders
Power budgets and mission profiles for mobile robots and wearable suits
Integration: mass, volume, packaging, crash safety and serviceability
